summary: Ran all 6 requested checks across backend + frontend for iteration 9 (self-edit guard, forgot-password rate limit, admin ride-reminder trigger, self ProfileModal DOM, admin editing others, Strava RSVP deep-link + persistence). All 6 pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1624 lines — starting to feel large; splitting auth/rides/riders into routers would help maintainability but not urgent.

send_pending_ride_reminders returns a differently-shaped dict when RESEND_API_KEY is missing ({sent, skipped, reason}) vs when present ({rides_reminded, emails_sent}). Callers/tests need to branch. Consider always returning the same keys for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Test 3 seeds one existing ride's starts_at to now+24h; no new documents created. Rate-limit test clears/repopulates password_reset_requests and cleans up after itself.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow requires the native-setter workaround because the phone-frame mock keeps the auth screen slightly out of Playwright's default visibility. Correct testids: submit-auth (not login-submit), tab-riders, tab-rides, rider-card-{id}, ride-card-{id}, member-card-edit, profile-close. RSVPs on rides are persisted in the ride's `rsvps` dict keyed by user id (values 'going'/'maybe'/'cant'); the top-level `going` array is null on Strava rides — that's expected, don't chase it.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found in this iteration

test_results_detail.test2_forgot_password_rate_limit: PASS — first 3 return 200, 4th returns 429 with 'Too many reset requests' detail; different email still returns 200.
test_results_detail.test3_admin_ride_reminder_trigger: PASS — /api/admin/send-ride-reminders returns 200 with {rides_reminded, emails_sent}; both are ints. Seeded-ride variant returns rides_reminded >= 1 when the going list has users, else 0 (documented healthy no-op).
test_results_detail.test4_self_profile_modal_dom: PASS — For self, profile-bio and profile-photo-button are NOT in DOM; profile-name + coffee grid + profile-since block ('Member since August 2026' + '#0001') are all present.
